title: ** Iranian MP Sara Fallahi Says 37% of U.S. Women Report Sexual Abuse Affecting Themselves or Family Members**
text:
** Iranian MP Sara Fallahi Says 37% of U.S. Women Report Sexual Abuse Affecting Themselves or Family Members**"

"Sara Fallahi, Chair of the Human Rights Committee of the Iranian Parliament (Majlis), said a significant proportion of American women report that they or a family member have experienced discrimination, particularly gender-based discrimination."

"Citing detailed survey figures, Fallahi said 37 percent of women in a survey of 3,453 American women said they or a family member had been subjected to sexual abuse. She added that 29 percent said they or their families had been threatened or sexually harassed, while more than 21 percent—about one in five—said they or their family members had experienced violence because they are women."

"Fallahi also pointed to the legal challenges facing these women, saying concerns that various U.S. institutions cannot secure their rights have led them to refrain from seeing a doctor, seeking health care, or reporting to police.
